voice: An ancient, inhuman voice speaking from deep underground, very low and gravelly, slow and patient, cruel and quietly amused, like a buried god whispering through stone.
reference_text: So, something small has come crawling down into my halls. Walk on, little thief. Every step you take, I feel it in the stone.

delivery.open: Low and inviting, patient, a hungry whisper.
delivery.noticed: A sudden, quiet, chilling realisation. Slow.
delivery.wave: Low and commanding, calling something up out of the dark.
delivery.collapse: Furious and thunderous, shouting in rage and pain, the voice of a dying thing.
delivery.minute: Cold and taunting, unhurried, enjoying the fear.
delivery.thirty: Urgent and menacing, raising the voice, savage.
delivery.ten: Screaming and urgent, very fast, a roar over falling rock.
delivery.sealed_in: Quiet, final and satisfied, a door closing forever.
delivery.sealed_out: Calm, gloating, keeping what was left behind.
delivery.overtime: Mocking and delighted, a slow cruel laugh in the voice.
delivery.escape: Bitter and grudging, a low growl of disappointment.

open: A door opens. Come down to me.
Come in, little thief. Come in.
Yes... another one for the dark.
noticed: You have lingered. Now I have noticed you.
collapse: You killed my keeper! Now these halls come down on you!
It falls! All of it falls! Run, little thief!
My heart is dead, and I will bury you with it!
minute: One minute. Listen to the ceiling.
thirty: Thirty seconds! Do you hear the stone breaking?
Thirty seconds, and the roof comes down!
ten: Ten seconds! Run, or stay forever!
sealed_in: The door is shut. Only the stairs remain, if you can reach them.
Sealed. Nobody is coming for you now.
sealed_out: Sealed. What you left behind is mine.
The door is shut. I keep what I am given.
overtime: Stay a while. They are almost upon you.
escape: You got out. Keep what you stole, for now.
Run, then. I will still be here.
